title: Kyl olis se ensimmäinen tarvinnut silmälasit
subtitle: Review lesson — reading a harder real review, halfway checkpoint

blocks.text: Twenty lessons in, halfway through the plan. Lessons 7-19 buried you in cases, possessives, relative clauses, the imperative, infinitives, and numbers — a lot of machinery. This lesson doesn't add anything new. It just hands you one genuinely hard, unsimplified review and lets you watch all of that machinery fire at once.

items.fi: Sain palvelua Espoon {autohuollossa|grammar|inessive|at the car service centre}.
{Autoni|grammar|possessive suffix|my car} hinattiin kolme {kertaa|grammar|partitive after number|times}.

blocks.text: Now — a harder real review, fully annotated

blocks.title: Read it once unaided first
blocks.text: This one is intentionally messier than Lesson 6's reading — real spoken-register Finnish, with a colloquial quoted line right in the middle. Try it cold first, then check the annotations.

blocks.content: {Vein|grammar|1st person past, irregular|I took} auton huoltoon ja saivat sen korjattua. Löysivät samalla lisävikoja ja laskivat niille alustavasti laskun.

Kun sitten {vein|grammar|1st person past, irregular|I took} auton luottohuoltoon toiselle paikkakunnalle, sanoi tämä että kyl {olis|grammar|conditional, colloquial for olisi|would} se ensimmäinen {tarvinnut|grammar|past participle|needed} silmälasit, {ei|grammar|negation, 3rd person|is not} täällä mikään {rikki|word|adjective|broken} ole.

blocks.title: Olis — the colloquial cousin of olisi
blocks.text: You know olisi (Lesson 5) as the formal conditional of on. In casual speech — including a quoted mechanic in this review — the final vowel often drops: olisi becomes {olis|grammar|conditional, colloquial|would}. Same meaning, same -isi- engine, just worn down the way fast speech wears down endings in any language.

blocks.title: A handful of bonus words in this text
blocks.text: Silmälasit means 'glasses/spectacles' — the mechanic's sarcastic joke is that the first shop 'would have needed glasses', i.e. couldn't see straight. Paikkakunnalle is 'to a locality/town' (allative, Lesson 17's family). Lisävikoja is 'additional faults' (partitive plural, Lesson 10's family: lisä- + vika). Alustavasti means 'preliminarily'.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What did the second repair shop say about the first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.fi: Sanoivat, että ensimmäinen olis tarvinnut silmälasit — ei siellä mikään rikki ollut.
lines.en: They said the first one would've needed glasses — nothing there was actually broken.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Did you find additional faults yourself?

lines.speaker: B
lines.fi: En. Ensimmäinen korjaamo laski niistä laskun turhaan.
lines.en: No. The first repair shop billed for them for nothing.
